title: TECMP: Cleanup and fix units
description:
- The Voltage was not showing the unit V.
- The temperatures now use directly the base unit degree Celsius.

notes.body: I do wonder, why the base unit is shown for photo_tree_add_item and not for proto_tree_add_double. Am I using the APIs wrong or should proto_tree_add_double add base units too?
This bug affects 4.0 too.

added 17 commits
  • 2f299beb...34d3f122 - 16 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • d61fb4fc - TECMP: Cleanup and fix units
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9983/diffs?diff_id=622235581&start_sha=2f299beb99bea88806c9909e13e619b5cc8d8796)
use also base_uint ?

I am not sure I understand. The value is encoded as two ints that need to be combined into a double (line 1241). This should create a header field item with value and base unit. E.g. "12.34 V"

The problem I am having is that `proto_tree_add_item` adds the base unit but `proto_tree_add_double` does not add the base unit, so I need to add it manually.
Oh yes, may be with BASE_CUSTOM ?

Yes, BASE_CUSTOM would work but then I just add the BASE_UNIT myself in the custom function.

I hoped their is a ways to avoid "adding the BASE_UNIT" by code, when using protocol_tree_add_double.

I change the MR to BASE_CUSTOM. Should I push that change?

You could use `protocol_tree_add_double_format_value`, but yeah, the functions like `protocol_tree_add_int` and so on don't use any of the strings elements like BASE_UNIT_STRING when displaying. (Maybe they should?)

I looked a bit around: it seems that BASE_UNIT_STRING works for uints but not for doubles. 

- uint:   proto_tree_add_item and proto_tree_add_uint   --> works (even up to uint64)
- double: proto_tree_add_item and proto_tree_add_double --> do not add BASE_UNIT (and this is not caught as error)

unit_strings provides:
- unit_name_string_get_value
- unit_name_string_get_value64
- unit_name_string_get_double

proto.c create using these only:
- hf_try_val_to_str
- hf_try_val64_to_str
- nothing for double!

So this seems to be a limitation in proto.c, while unit_name_string does support double.

I guess protocol_tree_add_double_format_value is the easiest work around then.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9983/diffs?diff_id=623007372&start_sha=d61fb4fcc271dff3b3d1302250475ab706edd1a0#7b54d2d9f70333b5ed4eb3d561e4af7dc1f24ece_1242_1242)

The following patch would add base unit support for FT_DOUBLE: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10006

Would that make more sense?
I guess we can just fix the issue in packet-tecmp for the time being and have the discussion in the other MR!?

Yes

Thanks
